title: A Conversation with Rep. Sam McKenzie: Reflections from the Tennessee Legislature
description:
Join the Anderson County Democratic Women’s Club for a special evening with Tennessee State Representative Sam McKenzie on Monday, June 23 at 5:30 p.m. at 201 Café and Wine Bar, 201 Broadway Ave., Oak Ridge. Rep. McKenzie will offer insight into this year’s Tennessee General Assembly session, discuss legislative developments, and share his perspective as Chair of the Tennessee Black Caucus of State Legislators.

A veteran of both public service and scientific leadership, McKenzie represents Knoxville’s District 15 and serves on key committees including Education, Health, Government Operations, and House Ethics. He is a former Knox County Commissioner and retired leader from Oak Ridge National Laboratory, now running a small business in Knoxville.

This event is an opportunity to hear directly from one of Tennessee’s most engaged legislative voices. Light refreshments will be provided, and drinks will be available for purchase. All are welcome. For more information, contact the Democratic Women’s Club at ac-democratic-women@outlook.com.

title: Community Conversations: Local Impacts of Medicaid and SNAP Cuts
description:
The Big Ugly Bill has passed the house and now is the time to make your voice heard. The bill calls for devastating cuts to Medicaid, SNAP, and the safety net, all to pay for tax breaks for the ultra-wealthy. Pennsylvania voters, like voters in other states, strongly support these programs, and with good reason. Medicaid provides critical support for millions of Pennsylvanians.

The reconciliation bill will terminate healthcare coverage for around 13 million Americans and kick approximately 3 million Americans off of SNAP. While new requirements for the state to help pay for the SNAP program would result in new expenditures for the state of $226 million to over a billion. The bill does all this harm while adding $2.4 trillion to the federal deficit.

This event is open to everyone. Join Pennsylvanians Together and the Pennsylvania Policy Center, for a real conversation about proposals that could harm Pennsylvanians, and what we can do about them. NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from President Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


The flag doesn’t belong to the Trump administration. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings.**
Check out nokings.org for more information.

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*

title: WORKSHOP | Yes, you can host a house party! (Nationwide-focus)
description:
*How to Host a House Party Workshop for National House Races*

**Why host a house party?** 

Yes, door knocks, phone banks, postcards, rallies are all important organizing tools. But in 2025-26, we need to do something more and different to win. House parties can:

- Reach voters outside of our political bubbles

- Have friend and neighbor conversations with those who support our democratic values

- Inoculate voters against the onslaught of right-wing media

- Expand our volunteer base

**Are you thinking about hosting a house party, but don't know how to get started?** If you've never hosted one before (and even if you're a fellow introvert), or just want a refresher, join the Bay Area Coalition every Monday, 5 pm (PT) / 7 pm (CT) / 8 pm (ET) for our nationwide house party workshop ...

- How to plan your house party

- Tips and tools for hosting conversations with your friends, neighbors, colleagues

_You'll leave the workshop fired up and ready to host your house party!_

Sign up here for ** *California* ** house party workshops - https://www.mobilize.us/cadems/event/759747/

For more Bay Area Coalition actions: https://bayareacoalition.org/

title: Bake Back Better TX and Blue Horizon Texas: Blueberry Cupcakes!
description:
Our friends at Bake Back Better Texas are dedicating their June bake to Blue Horizon Texas. Donate $35+ today to support our mission... and get a sweet treat. Learn more below!

Hello fellow cupcake & democracy lovers!

We’re excited to announce our newest cupcake beneficiary, Blue Horizon Texas!
Blue Horizon Texas recruits, prepares, and supports Democratic and progressive candidates running in rural, exurban, and traditionally Republican districts in Texas by improving the support infrastructure, knowledge base, and resources available for non-traditional candidates in underinvested races across the state.

When you donate $35 or more to Blue Horizon through our ActBlue fundraiser, we will reward you with 4 scrumptious blueberry cupcakes delivered right to your door in Austin proper or Houston (inside the loop or Oak Forest area). If you are outside of our delivery areas, you can choose to pick up your cupcakes or gift them to this bake’s community helper beneficiary.

Texas is worth fighting for!
Sarah Suarez and Milana Noueilaty
Houston & Austin Hub Leaders

Donation Deadline for Cupcakes: Sunday, June 22                                 
Delivery Dates: June 27-29
Delivery Areas: Houston (inside the loop or Oak Forest Area) & Austin 
💙Donate $35+ at https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bakeforblue and get a sweet reward right to your door.*
